result: Replace the `x_d` and `acc1`–`acc7` transposed accumulation structure with an eight-sample delay line and a registered sum of its taps, preserving the current output cycle alignment and synchronous reset behavior. For each symmetric tap pair, use a signed pre-add and one multiplication only when that pair’s coefficient parameters are equal; otherwise retain the exact two independent products, so all supported parameter overrides preserve their behavior. Sum the resulting 32-bit products modulo 32 bits with a balanced tree, retain `// @latency 1`, and evaluate against the incumbent’s 1.387 ns register-to-register WNS with all fixed verification and routed-report gates.
